title: Animated Testimonials
description: Crossfades portraits behind a rotating quote.

a11y.motion: Autoplay is off and the pause button is hidden. Changing slides with the dots swaps the portrait and quote instantly, with no scale, rotate or slide.
a11y.keyboard: The pause/play button and the dots are native buttons with visible focus rings and 24px hit areas. Autoplay also pauses while the pointer or focus is inside the component.
a11y.screenReader: Each dot is named "Show testimonial from {name}" with aria-current on the shown one, the quote is a blockquote, and slide changes are not announced.
